Are you looking for meaningful work that has a direct impact on people's health and well-being?  Become a warehouse employee at Rhenus Warehousing Solutions in Tilburg! With your strong sense of responsibility and focus on quality, you will play a crucial role in preparing our orders. - Packing goods according to applicable guidelines and safety regulations.
- Assist with inbound activities, including splitting checking and receiving incoming shipments.
- Ensuring strict quality controls to ensure our products meet the highest standards.
- Performing various other tasks according to team and customer needs.

What do we ask of you?

- Are you flexibly deployable for various tasks;
- Do you have a good command of the English language, as all our work instructions are in English;
- As a team player with a proactive attitude, you bring a positive atmosphere with you.
- Available 40h a week (working hours 9.00-18.00), overtime may occur; We complete orders to allow all scheduled operations to go ahead
- So, are you ready to take up the challenge and make a difference in our Medical Warehouse? Then don't hesitate

- Load and unload trucks

- You speak Dutch or English
- You can travel independently to Helmond
- You are physically fit and enjoy active work
- You are available for day shifts from 08:00 AM to 04:30 PM

• Travel Benefits: Receive travel allowance for commutes over 5 km. 
• Career Growth: Enjoy opportunities to develop and grow within the Amstel Hotel

jobs.occupation: Logistics Employee Reach Truck at DHL Bemmel (121134003)
jobs.description:
Will you be driving a reach truck at DHL in Bemmel soon?

Would you like to start in logistics and develop yourself into a reach truck driver? At our new DHL Supply Chain location in Bemmel, we are looking for logistics employees who want to work with a reach truck.

No certificate yet? No problem: DHL will train you internally to become a reach truck driver – fully on the job and at our expense.

What will you do?

- Operating a reach truck to store and retrieve goods, including at height
- Moving pallets and goods throughout the warehouse
- Picking and scanning orders
- Processing incoming and outgoing goods
- Ensuring a clean, safe, and organized workplace

You will work at a location that is continuously developing, where new clients are regularly being onboarded. This means you will constantly learn new processes.

Good to know: working hours

In July, August, and September, we operate three shifts to handle the busy period:

- 06:00 – 15:00
- 08:00 – 17:00
- 15:00 – 24:00

From October onwards, you will switch to regular day shifts (Monday to Friday between 07:00 and 18:00). Your weekends will be free.

Due to the early and late shifts during the first months, own transportation is recommended.

Who are you?

- You are at least 18 years old
- You are eager to learn and want to develop into a reach truck driver
- You work accurately and with a focus on safety
- You are available for 32 to 40 hours per week in day shifts, Monday to Friday between 07:00 and 18:00
- You speak Dutch or English

A reach truck certificate is a plus, but not required, we value motivation and commitment more, and we will provide your internal training at DHL.

As a reach truck operator at Rhenus Logistics, you play a key role in keeping warehouse operations running efficiently. You support order pickers and help ensure a smooth and organized workflow throughout the day.

Your main responsibilities:

- Operating the reach truck to pick items and replenish stock locations
- Supplying order pickers with the right materials on time
- Staying alert and supporting colleagues whenever needed

Working hours: Monday to Friday, with shifts from 07:00–16:00 or 08:00–17:00

Ready to make an impact in a dynamic warehouse environment? Join the Rhenus team today! 🔥

What we’re looking for:

- A valid reach truck certificate or relevant hands-on experience
- Full-time availability (40 hours per week) and a reliable, team-focused mindset
- Good English communication skills
